kypExtensions.summary: The vaccine spectrum read as one trade (replication drives dual-arm response strength; live lessons last, dead lessons need review) with one exception (mRNA achieves live-like dual-arm immunity without organisms) and one engineering fix (conjugation = the T-cell face for naked polysaccharides); plus the timing logic of combined passive + active prophylaxis for exposures whose incubation outruns active onset.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source tables present the five designs as parallel entries without the trade-fix-exception frame or the timing rationale; these integrations are KYP's design. The pregnancy-influenza/Tdap recommendations and PCV13-schedule details in the pattern are labeled extension.
